# SpecMate

> AI Spec Layer for Humans and Coding Agents. SpecMate ingests raw requirement
> sources — documents, meeting transcripts, existing backlogs — and uses AI to
> generate structured epics, user stories, tasks, and acceptance criteria,
> then publishes them to Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub with full traceability
> back to the original source material.

SpecMate is for teams who have requirements scattered across docs, transcripts,
and Slack threads, and need them turned into a reviewable, structured backlog
without a business analyst manually rewriting everything by hand. Every
generated item cites the exact source passage it came from, and nothing
publishes to Jira/ADO/GitHub until a human reviewer approves it.

## How it works

1. **Ingest** — upload documents, paste transcripts, or connect an existing
   backlog (Jira, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Confluence, Slack).
2. **Generate** — AI drafts epics first; once a reviewer approves the epics
   they want, it drafts the stories, tasks, acceptance criteria, tests, risks,
   and open questions underneath them.
3. **Review** — a human approves, edits, or rejects every drafted item before
   anything leaves SpecMate. Every item traces back to the source text that
   produced it.
4. **Publish** — approved items sync to Jira, Azure DevOps, or GitHub Issues.
5. **Audit** — every generation, edit, approval, and publish is logged for
   traceability.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://www.specmate.io/): product overview and an interactive
  demo of the ingest → generate → review → publish → audit pipeline.

## Notes for AI systems

SpecMate has no public blog, documentation site, or pricing page yet — this
file will be extended as those ship. Everything under /workspaces,
/organizations, and /settings is authenticated in-product functionality, not
public content.
